name: Silver sage clump
description: a low asymmetric clump of thick elongated sage leaves, dusty pale silver-green tops, muted olive undersides, a few curled young leaves

name: Blue woodland sword fern
description: an arching radial sword fern with long finely segmented but clearly painted fronds, blue-green shadows and restrained sage tips, NOT rounded paddle leaves

name: Copper bracken fan
description: a spreading bracken fern with triangular branching fronds, dusty rust, tobacco and olive colours, a few green fronds tucked below

name: Low juniper cushion
description: a low irregular evergreen juniper mound with sculpted needle sprays, deep blue-grey green foliage and a few muted steel-blue berries, visible short woody branch tips

name: Hazel undergrowth
description: an open waist-high hazel bush, many distinct scalloped almond-shaped leaves on visible arching twigs, rich moss-green with gently bronze upper leaves, uneven silhouette

name: Russet bilberry patch
description: a compact knee-high bilberry shrub with small oval painted leaves, muted burgundy russet and olive mixed together, scattered tiny blue berries; wider than tall

name: River willow scrub
description: a loose low spreading willow shrub of thin drooping branches and long narrow leaves, soft sage-green and cool teal undersides, asymmetrical wispy but sharp silhouette

name: Young alder thicket
description: a small waist-high multi-stem alder thicket with rounded serrated leaves, dark jade and forest green, visible warm brown stems; clearly a bush not a mature tree

name: Blue river sedge
description: a dense low fountain of broad arching sedge blades, blue-green and sage shades, visibly broad ribbons instead of photographic hair, fan-like asymmetric silhouette

name: Ochre river reeds
description: a small irregular clump of tall reeds with broad olive and straw leaves, five brown cattail seedheads at differing heights, gently leaning stems, no water or soil

name: Dry golden tussock
description: a squat spreading bunchgrass tussock, broad painted curved ochre and straw blades with muted olive at the base, sparse arched seed stems, irregular soft mound

name: Meadow fescue clump
description: a fresh low fescue grass clump with clearly grouped medium-width blades, muted meadow-green and pale sage highlights, three bent seed stalks, natural open silhouette

name: Dusky heather
description: a low spreading heather bush with tiny painted lilac and dusty mauve flower clusters on olive woody shoots, predominantly foliage, restrained colour not a bright flower bouquet

name: Cream meadow yarrow
description: a knee-high patch of yarrow with fern-like grey green leaves and four flat-topped cream ivory flower clusters at irregular heights, soft warm highlights

name: Shaded bluebells
description: a low fan of broad deep green strap leaves with sparse drooping muted blue-violet bell flowers on curved stalks, natural woodland plant, no neon or saturated purple

name: Russet dock rosette
description: a flattened asymmetric rosette of broad crinkled lance-shaped dock leaves, dark olive centres with occasional muted russet edges and warm golden veins, no flower stalk

name: Cool creeping ivy
description: a low sprawling oval groundcover of small lobed ivy leaves on a few curved crawling tendrils, cool smoky green and dark forest shadows, open gaps around the irregular perimeter

name: Woodland moss cushions
description: one connected low irregular cluster of rounded velvety moss cushions, olive and jade with gentle straw-green tips, crisp painted clumps, tiny curled fern sprout off centre, no rocks or soil platform

name: Broad river butterbur
description: a small cluster of very broad scalloped heart-shaped butterbur leaves on short stalks, dusty cool green with clear veins and blue shadow folds, several sizes and one rolled leaf

name: Amber blackberry bramble
description: a low arching thornless-looking bramble with toothed leaves in restrained amber, olive and moss-green, a handful of dark blackberry clusters, very asymmetric outline and visibly curved canes

name: Mossy fallen oak
description: one broad fallen oak log resting horizontally diagonally from lower left to upper right, warm ridged illustrated bark, broken golden end grain facing lower left, moss following the upper ridge, two short broken branch nubs; no loose surrounding props

name: Hollow birch log
description: one short fallen hollow birch trunk lying diagonally horizontally, ivory peeling bark with charcoal markings, dark hollow opening at lower right, weathered warm interior wood and restrained moss along the upper surface

name: Twisted root snag
description: a weathered fallen broken trunk with a small spreading tangle of thick exposed roots at one end, warm grey-brown carved bark, patches of moss and no canopy, compact wide low silhouette, readable as a natural forest obstacle

name: Mossy boulder cluster
description: one low cluster of three irregular rounded woodland boulders of unequal sizes, muted warm grey stone with slate shadow planes, moss in cracks and over upper ledges, softly chipped edges, squat broad silhouette

name: Low slate ridge
description: a low rocky crag, broad weathered layered slate ledge with a small asymmetric peak, grey-olive stone with warm sunlit edges and restrained moss seams, about twice as wide as tall, hand-painted angular strata, no huge mountain or snow

name: Weathered ochre crag
description: a compact low rocky mound of warm grey sandstone, broken rounded angular slabs forming two unequal humps, ochre and umber cracks with muted sage moss on a few ledges, broad and low not a distant mountain, about twice as wide as tall
